chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id, from Fadalah ibn Ayyub, from Rifa'ah, who said:
I asked Abā ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام about a man who commits zina before he consummates with his wife: is he to be stoned? He said: “No.”
ai.seo_question: Is a man who commits zina before consummating marriage subject to stoning in Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning the hadd of zina in the case of a married man before consummation with his wife. Imam Abā ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام states that such a person is not subject to rajm (stoning).
